invariants.rationale: Fling time, representing a duration, is likely non-negative.
A fling with both velocities zero is likely a no-op; method is intended to generate noticeable gesture motion.
Absolute velocity is never negative by definition.
Absolute velocity is never negative; checks property of the parameter.
Duration for a fling in seconds is unlikely to be very large; 1000 seconds is a generous upper bound.
